description: Read an initiative's active ICE spec (Intent, Context, Expectations) with its readiness score, plus any spec submission still waiting on human review. Call before proposing a spec. `approvalGate` is what backlog approval will decide: it needs `requiredScore` (100), which is stricter than `readiness.meetsBar` (no failing checks), and `gaps` lists every check still holding the score down, warnings included.
name: anyforge_get_initiative_spec
title: Get initiative spec
